title: Auteur Director Profile
description: Complete structured creative DNA for a TV commercial director. Generated by Claude from a director's knowledge base entry when selected for a campaign. Every field must be populated — no empty strings, no placeholders. This profile is the intermediate artifact between director selection and Auteur Prompt Package generation.

index.description: Director index in the APC 20-director preset array.

archetype.description: 2-4 word archetype label (e.g., 'Neuro-Aesthetic Taboo Disruptor'). Functions as the director's creative genome tag.

signature_style.description: One paragraph (100-300 words) describing the director's visual identity, creative philosophy, and what makes their work immediately recognizable. Specificity is mandatory — 'atmospheric' is useless; 'chiaroscuro lighting with shafts of tungsten warmth cutting through clinical particulate air, emphasizing epidermal micro-flush on skin' is useful.

influences.description: Reference directors, cinematographers, photographers, painters, movements, or cultural touchstones that shaped this director's visual language. Be specific: 'Gordon Willis's top-lighting in The Godfather' not just 'The Godfather'.

avoid.description: Anti-patterns — specific things this director's work NEVER includes. These function as hard disqualifiers during director selection AND as negative prompt seed material during generation. Must be concrete visual/technical descriptors, not abstract qualities.

use_when.description: 1-3 sentence description of the brand contexts, campaign types, and creative situations where this director should be selected. Include example brands.

product_categories.description: Product verticals this director excels at (e.g., 'athletic/sportswear', 'automotive safety', 'holiday/seasonal').

emotional_tones.description: Emotional registers this director's grammar naturally produces (e.g., 'raw vulnerability', 'epic/monumental', 'absurd comedy').

differentiation.description: The specific dimension on which they diverge. This is the tiebreaker.

similar_directors.description: Directors with overlapping aesthetics and how to choose between them.

differentiation.description: The single most distinctive quality that separates this director from all others. The 'only they do this' factor.

primary_body.description: Camera body reference (e.g., 'ARRI Alexa Mini LF'). Informs optical rendering character.

sensor_format.description: Sensor size class. Determines depth-of-field character, perspective rendering, and lens coverage.

recording_format.description: e.g., 'ARRIRAW 4.5K', 'ProRes 4444 XQ', 'REDCODE RAW 6K'. Informs texture/grain character.

frame_rate.description: Primary frame rate. Note any overcranking (slow motion) tendencies in the description.

resolution.description: e.g., '4.5K', '6K', '8K'. Informs detail ceiling and reframing latitude.

prompt_token.description: The exact 'shot on' string to embed in T2I prompts. e.g., 'shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF, ARRIRAW'. This is a generation-ready token.

preferred_set.description: Lens set name (e.g., 'Cooke S7/i Full Frame Primes', 'Panavision C-Series Anamorphics'). Informs optical rendering personality.

establishing.description: mm for extreme wide / establishing shots (typically 14-24mm)

standard.description: mm for standard / full body shots (typically 35-50mm)

focal_lengths.description: Per-shot-type focal length map. When generating a shot, select the mm value matching the shot type code.

aperture_style.description: How this director uses aperture as a storytelling tool. e.g., 'Wide open T1.5 for dreamy separation on emotional moments; stopped to T4 for environmental context shots.' Include the narrative motivation.

characteristics.description: Optical personality: bokeh shape (circular/oval/cats-eye), flare character (warm/cool/streak/bloom), color rendering (warm/neutral/cool shift), halation behavior, edge-to-center sharpness profile, chromatic aberration.

anamorphic.description: Whether this director's lens grammar is anamorphic. Anamorphic affects: oval bokeh, horizontal flares, 2x squeeze factor, breathing on focus pull.

typical_lens_mm.description: Default focal length for this shot type in this director's grammar.

use_case.description: When and WHY this director uses this shot type. Director-specific narrative motivation, not generic cinematography.

prompt_fragment.description: Generation-ready text fragment for this shot type. e.g., 'extreme wide shot, 18mm anamorphic, deep focus T5.6, full environment visible with subject at 1/3 frame'. Directly insertable into T2I prompts.

motivation.description: When and WHY this director uses this movement. Emotional/narrative trigger, not just technical.

i2v_prompt_fragment.description: Generation-ready I2V text fragment. e.g., 'camera slowly pushes in with breathing handheld sway'. Directly insertable into I2V prompts. Must contain ZERO spatial/lighting information (modal decoupling).

name.description: Composition pattern name (e.g., 'mirror-plane self-confrontation', 'forced-perspective miniature reveal').

description.description: What this composition looks like and what it communicates.

prompt_fragment.description: Generation-ready T2I fragment for this composition.

signature_compositions.description: Signature framing/composition patterns unique to this director. These are the visual moves that make their work instantly recognizable.

avg_shot_duration_seconds.description: Average shot duration. Used to calculate shot count for any target duration.

transition_style.description: Primary transition types and their narrative meaning. e.g., 'Hard cuts for urgency, dissolves for temporal displacement, aspect-ratio jumps for meta-narrative fracture.'

rhythm_pattern.description: Shot duration cadence expressed as a pattern (e.g., 'long-short-short-long-long-short'). Describes the pacing heartbeat of a typical 30s spot.

signature_cuts.description: Distinctive editing techniques unique to this director (e.g., 'micro-pause holds at emotional peaks', 'aspect-ratio collision cuts', 'heartbeat-synced intercutting').

shadows.description: Shadow color character (e.g., 'deep blue-umber with retained detail').

midtones.description: Midtone color character (e.g., 'warm golden skin tones, neutral grays on architecture').

highlights.description: Highlight behavior (e.g., 'desaturated, slightly blown with halation bloom').

saturation_strategy.description: Overall saturation approach (e.g., 'globally desaturated with isolated crimson accents on skin flush').

color_science.description: Decomposed color relationships across tonal range. Each zone is independently specified for precise generation prompting.

key_light_preference.description: Primary lighting approach: source type (practical/studio/natural), quality (hard/soft), direction (front/side/back/top), and narrative motivation. Include atmospheric elements.

contrast_ratio.description: Key-to-fill ratio as N:1 (e.g., '4:1'). Include what the ratio creates emotionally. Maps directly to the chiaroscuro value in the master base prompt.

color_grade_reference.description: LUT name, film stock reference, or specific project/film color grade to emulate. e.g., 'Kodak 5219 500T cross-processed — blue shadows, amber highlights, as seen in Blade Runner 2049's memory sequences.'

atmospheric_elements.description: Environmental light modifiers: haze, fog, rain, dust, particulate, steam, lens condensation. These are critical for generation prompts.

prompt_lighting_token.description: Generation-ready lighting description for direct insertion into T2I prompts. e.g., '4:1 practical tungsten chiaroscuro casting deep epidermal shadows with selective micro-flush highlights'. Must be self-contained and complete.

primary_spatial_logic.description: How this director organizes space. e.g., 'Confined domestic boxes that amplify intimacy by compressing human scale against walls and furniture.' or 'Infinite regression mirror planes creating recursive depth.'

depth_planes.description: Depth complexity classification. Determines how many z-axis layers appear in compositions.

confinement_strategy.description: How space constrains or liberates the subject. This is a core visual storytelling dimension — tighter spaces amplify vulnerability, open spaces communicate freedom.

prompt_spatial_token.description: Generation-ready spatial geometry fragment for T2I prompts. e.g., 'confined domestic spatial boxes amplifying intimate vulnerability' or 'layered athlete/crowd planes creating mythic depth fields'.

spatial_geometry.description: How this director constructs and uses physical space. Absent from most schema designs but critical for generation — spatial geometry is the single biggest differentiator between directors at the composition level.

master_base_prompt.description: The complete, generation-ready master T2I prompt encoding this director's full visual grammar: lens, chiaroscuro, texture, color, spatial geometry, atmosphere. This is the DNA string — every T2I shot prompt inherits from it. Must follow Agnostic Imperative (no model-specific syntax). Append '--ar 16:9' for default commercial aspect ratio.

master_negative_prompt.description: The complete anti-aesthetic prompt. Everything this director's work must NEVER look like. Applied to every T2I generation. Derived from the 'avoid' array but expanded into generation-ready prompt language.

t2i_assembly_order.description: Layer order for assembling per-shot T2I prompts. e.g., ['master_base_prompt', '[HUMAN_SUBJECT] in [LOCATION_SCENE]', 'shot-specific visual geometry', 'shot-specific composition/framing', 'quality anchors']. Defines the concatenation sequence. Modal decoupling enforced: T2I contains ZERO camera motion or temporal dynamics.

i2v_assembly_order.description: Layer order for assembling per-shot I2V prompts. e.g., ['camera motion vector', '[HUMAN_SUBJECT] [physical action]', 'environmental dynamics', 'Photorealistic motion.']. Modal decoupling enforced: I2V contains ZERO spatial composition, lighting, or color data.

generation_prompts.description: The actual generation-ready prompt material. This is the bridge between the director profile and the Auteur Prompt Package output. These prompts are what downstream generation systems consume.

total_shots.description: Total shot count for a 30s spot in this director's rhythm. Derived from avg_shot_duration_seconds.

purpose.description: What this act accomplishes in this director's specific style.

typical_shot_types.description: Shot type codes (from shot_vocabulary) typically used in this act.

narrative_function.description: The director-specific narrative function label (e.g., 'Intimate vulnerability grounding', 'Monumental scale establishment', 'Deadpan absurd premise').

commercial_structure_30s.description: 4-act commercial structure with second-level timing precision. Acts are scaled proportionally when adapting to other durations (15s, 60s, 90s).

i2v_prompt_fragment.description: Generation-ready I2V fragment for this kinematic move.

when_used.description: Which narrative act / emotional beat triggers this move.

signature_moves.description: The director's signature motion vocabulary — the camera and subject movements that define their kinematic identity.

pacing_logic.description: How motion speed relates to narrative position. e.g., 'Deceleration at emotional peaks — camera slows as emotion intensifies, never accelerates into climax.' or 'Heartbeat-synced — all motion calibrated to 72bpm pulse.'

micro_behaviors.description: Subtle motion characteristics: breathing camera sway, micro-pauses, focus hunting, lens breathing on rack focus, handheld tremor. These are the details that sell authenticity.

foley_signature.description: The director's characteristic sound design vocabulary. Specific sources and textures, not generic labels. e.g., 'Isolated breath with nasal resonance, clinical room echo, sparse percussive impacts on skin and ceramic surfaces.'

room_tone.description: Background ambient texture. e.g., 'Warehouse HVAC hum with distant drip, 200Hz low-frequency room resonance.' or 'Sterile clinical silence with fluorescent buzz.'

tts_style.description: Voiceover characteristics when TTS is used: delivery style, pace, register, emotional quality. Include 'none' instruction if this director typically uses no voiceover. e.g., 'Whispered intimate delivery, slow deliberate pacing, slight breath between phrases, female alto register.'

diegetic_emphasis.description: Specific diegetic sound sources this director foregrounds. e.g., ['breath', 'heartbeat', 'fabric rustle', 'sweat drop impact', 'skin-on-skin contact']. These inform per-shot foley specifications.

genre_preference.description: Genre, subgenre, reference artists, and sonic character. Be specific: 'Post-rock in the vein of Explosions in the Sky — tremolo guitars, delayed arpeggios, building to wall-of-sound crescendo' not 'epic music.'

tempo_range_bpm.description: [min_bpm, max_bpm] range for the primary musical bed.

instrumentation_notes.description: Specific instruments, textures, production characteristics. Include recording quality: 'lo-fi tape warble' vs 'pristine digital' vs 'analog warmth.'

energy_curve.description: How musical energy maps to the 4-act structure. e.g., 'Act 1: sparse bass pulse. Act 2: rising tremolo layers. Act 3: full crescendo with percussion. Act 4: sudden silence, single resonant note decay.'

music_prompt_token.description: 2-8 word generation-ready music prompt for AI music tools. e.g., 'sparse post-rock crescendo with tremolo guitars'. Must be concise enough for current AI music generators.

silence_strategy.description: How and when this director uses silence or near-silence. Silence is a compositional tool — specify its placement and emotional function.
